name: Dhu Al Jalaali Wa Al Ikraam
description: Allah possesses majesty and honour and bestows generosity upon His creation.
summary: Dhu Al Jalaali Wa Al Ikraam joins majesty with honour and generosity. The expression occurs in Quran 55:27 and 55:78, with grammatical variation. These attributes express His greatness and the honour and bounty He bestows.
